purpose: Separate corpus-conditioned rebuild variance from fit-seed variance after the one-anchor shared-corpus V2 pilot classified the source as mixed.

immutable_prior_failure.rule: This pilot cannot reopen, promote, reweight, subset-select, or otherwise rehabilitate the failed K=12 candidate.

corpus_factor.selection_rule: Deterministic stride-3 anchors starting at the lowest member id; chosen without using member strength, stability rank, pathology rank, or diagnostic desirability.
corpus_factor.corpus_size_rule: Each cell uses exactly one anchor member's original-size reconstructed final fullpool and specialist corpus. No pooling and no enlargement.

fit_factor.crossing_rule: Every corpus anchor is fitted once with each matched fit-seed id, producing exactly 16 cells.

primary_metrics.fit_only: For each corpus anchor, compute all six pairwise TVs among the four fit-seed cells; aggregate statewise mean and p95 over anchors.
primary_metrics.corpus_conditioned: For each matched fit-seed id, compute all six pairwise TVs among the four corpus-anchor cells; aggregate statewise mean and p95 over fit-seed ids.
primary_metrics.interaction_decomposition: Two-way crossed probability-space sum-of-squares over corpus, fit seed, and corpus-by-fit residual interaction; report normalized shares.

secondary_metrics: The same fit-only and corpus-conditioned comparisons on preflop 72o ALL_IN-legal states.
The same comparisons on postflop trips-plus Fold-legal states.
The same comparisons on postflop high-card/no-immediate-draw ALL_IN-legal states.
Per-action probability dispersion for FOLD, CHECK_CALL, POT_33, POT_50, POT_75, POT_100, and ALL_IN.

classification_rule.corpus_conditioned_larger: Both corpus/fit mean-TV and p95-TV ratios >= 1.25.
classification_rule.fit_seed_larger: Both corpus/fit mean-TV and p95-TV ratios <= 0.80.
classification_rule.note: These are research attribution bands, not promotion thresholds. The interaction share is mandatory context and can prevent overinterpreting either directional label.

next_branch_rule.corpus_conditioned_larger: Investigate standardized/expanded teacher-target corpus construction before any new candidate; confirm on a separately preregistered bank.
next_branch_rule.fit_seed_larger: Investigate optimization/model/loss stability before any new candidate; do not spend more teacher collection first.
next_branch_rule.mixed_interaction: Design a targeted intervention addressing both fit stability and corpus coverage, then validate it as a new candidate under a new preregistration.

exclusions: No member selection, dropping, weighting, reseeding, or threshold relaxation.
No training on any prior stability or research evaluation bank.
No use of current pilot outcomes to choose corpus anchors or fit seeds.
